digests.strippedSqlSha256: SHA-256 of the stored text when Wrangler's splitter removed comments
digests.sourceSqlSha256: SHA-256 of the stored text when the migration file was applied unsplit
digests.strippedTupleSha256: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify([type,name,tbl_name,sql]) in the stripped form: this tuple's share of the earlier pin
digests.canonicalTupleSha256: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify([canonicalVersion,canonical tuple]): the same for both forms
